sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3. Languoid page lach1251 'Lachirioag Zapotec' (bookkeeping) and yate1242 'Yatee Zapotec'.
sources.note: lach1251 carries no descriptive references at all; yate1242 lists only Jaeger & Van Valin 1982 (phonology article) and Van Valin 1998 (syntax chapter).

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority (submitted by Conrad Hurd, SIL). 2006. Change Request 2006-027: retire [ztc] Zapotec, Lachirioag, merge into [zty] Zapotec, Yatee (adopted 2007-07-18). 7 pp.
sources.note: Nothing on stress. States 'Zapotec, Lachirioag is now considered a dialect of Zapotec, Yatee' (p. 2); evidence: MXB intelligibility survey, San Cristobal Lachiruaj scored 97% on a San Andres Yaa text; Bob Earl considers it mutually intelligible (p. 3).
